text: {"features":[{"name":"Role motivation","description":"How clearly the letter explains why this specific Information Security Engineering role at Google is the applicant's deliberate next step.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in the job or company in generic terms and gives little sense of why this specific role is the right next step."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows sincere enthusiasm for security or scale but connects that interest only loosely to this team or position."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Links the role to one or two personal priorities such as secure defaults, backend work, or infrastructure leverage, but the rationale stays fairly general."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains a clear fit between the applicant's trajectory and several elements of this role, making the application feel intentionally targeted."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a sharp, memorable case that this exact role is a natural continuation of the applicant's past work, values, and future direction."}]},{"name":"Mission understanding","description":"How well the letter shows understanding of the concrete security-engineering problems this team is trying to solve.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Refers to security at a high level without showing understanding of the team's concrete work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions one role-relevant area such as vulnerability response or secure development, but with limited specificity about the underlying problem."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows working awareness of several team concerns, such as automation, lifecycle integration, or assisting developers, without much systems framing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Frames the job in terms of scalable security operations, foundational infrastructure, or reducing expert toil, showing clear understanding of why the work matters."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Articulates the team's mission as a coherent systems problem involving security automation, vulnerability handling, lifecycle controls, and scaled decision-making with strong precision."}]},{"name":"Production experience","description":"How strong the evidence is that the applicant has tested, maintained, and launched production software products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only baseline production experience, with limited scope, limited time in role, or little breadth across the software lifecycle."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows modest production experience with some testing, maintenance, and launch work, but still at relatively limited scale or duration."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid production experience across several services with clear involvement in building, operating, and releasing software."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial production experience that is clearly beyond the minimum, with repeated ownership of multiple launched services or several years of relevant work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially deep and mature production experience with broad lifecycle exposure, sustained operational responsibility, and multiple shipped systems."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How convincingly the letter establishes strong production use of Go for backend engineering.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only briefly, without indicating that it is central to the applicant's work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States experience with Go but gives little evidence of depth, backend responsibility, or sustained use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a regular production language used in meaningful software work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a primary language and links it to backend systems, services, or infrastructure ownership."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes Go expertise a core part of the application through sustained primary use in production backend engineering and clear technical ownership."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates production-grade Python use for services, tooling, or automation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or mentions it too vaguely to judge substantive experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python use in generic terms without showing production responsibility or importance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for internal tooling, services, automation, or analysis."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial Python ownership in production settings, such as team-critical tooling, services, or broad internal automation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Portrays Python as a deeply trusted engineering language with evidence of production rigor, reusable systems, or work depended on by other engineers."}]},{"name":"AI experience","description":"How much concrete, role-relevant experience the letter gives with AI systems in production.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of experience with AI or model-backed software."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI or language models only in passing, without concrete shipped work or operational detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes shipping AI or model-backed functionality in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes production AI work and also addresses evaluation, reliability, predictability, or safeguards."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial applied AI experience in which dependable behavior, evaluation, and controlled deployment are clearly part of the work."}]},{"name":"Agentic architecture","description":"How well the letter demonstrates experience designing systems with agents, especially agents constrained by backend infrastructure.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of building agentic or agent-based systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents vaguely without explaining how they are structured or controlled."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agentic tooling or pipelines with identifiable components and responsibilities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains how agents are paired with backend services or otherwise constrained through contracts, guardrails, or supervision."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong architectural thinking about agentic systems, including bounded tasks, decomposition, monitoring, logging, or explicit control boundaries."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"How concretely the letter shows experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, deduplication, or variant analysis.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no concrete evidence of automating vulnerability intake, triage, or response."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Suggests interest in reducing security toil but does not describe an actual vulnerability-handling system."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building general automation for vulnerability reports or triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes specific automated workflows such as classification, routing, deduplication, queue reduction, or variant analysis."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end ownership of a vulnerability-handling pipeline and clearly conveys major operational leverage or transformation."}]},{"name":"Security assessment","description":"How strongly the letter evidences hands-on assessment of system security.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of performing security assessments or reviews."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at security review exposure without describing methods, scope, or ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience with security assessments, code review, or threat modeling in general terms."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes structured assessment work using concrete practices such as threat modeling, attack-surface analysis, findings documentation, or remediation verification."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents substantial assessment depth with clear rigor and a builder's understanding of how design assumptions fail in real systems."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic strength","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates practical competence with data structures and algorithms relevant to backend and security tooling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of data structures or algorithms ability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength but does not support it with a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a general example of improving a system through a better algorithm or data structure."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a concrete, technically plausible example of using algorithms or structures to remove a bottleneck or simplify a hard problem."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Gives a strong example showing sophisticated algorithmic judgment applied to a high-impact or especially challenging systems problem."}]},{"name":"Engineering rigor","description":"How clearly the letter conveys disciplined habits around correctness, maintainability, and reliable systems for security-sensitive infrastructure.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives little sense of engineering discipline beyond generic software experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Suggests care about reliability or quality, but only in broad or aspirational terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a practical concern for maintainability, correctness, or inherited systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives concrete signals of disciplined engineering, such as testing, typing, guardrails, clear contracts, or operational care."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes rigorous craftsmanship a central part of the case, showing mature habits for building security-critical systems that others can safely rely on."}]},{"name":"Security engagement","description":"How much supplementary security credibility the letter shows through certifications, competitions, or other deliberate skill-building outside ordinary work claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no additional security signal beyond ordinary job experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Adds a light extra signal, such as a basic certification or casual participation in security activities."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one clear substantive extra signal, such as OSCP, serious CTF participation, or comparable deliberate practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides multiple extra security signals or one especially strong signal with clear seriousness and commitment."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional extra-professional security investment through a strong combination of demanding certifications, near-top competition results, or sustained adversarial practice."}]},{"name":"Independent initiative","description":"How strongly the letter shows self-directed technical contribution beyond normal job duties.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no meaningful technical contribution beyond normal job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small personal tool or occasional patch, but the extra work appears limited in scope or continuity."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful self-directed effort through regular upstream fixes, a maintained side project, or a moderate personal build."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial initiative through open-source maintainership, a real user base, or an ambitious self-built system."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional self-driven engineering through both sustained external contribution and technically ambitious independent work."}]},{"name":"Impact evidence","description":"How concretely the letter connects the applicant's work to measurable or clearly observable results.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mostly lists responsibilities or skills without showing what changed because of the work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Suggests positive outcomes but gives little concrete evidence of effect."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects several claims to observable improvements such as faster systems, reduced toil, or adopted tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly ties work to meaningful operational outcomes, with clear descriptions of what improved or who benefited."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes impact especially credible through quantified results, sharp before-and-after contrasts, or precise statements of leverage returned to a team."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement","description":"How clearly the letter frames security engineering as helping developers work safely through usable systems, defaults, and automation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not express a developer-facing security mindset and focuses only on building or finding issues."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows general interest in secure systems but says little about helping other engineers work securely."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly values secure defaults, reduced toil, or tools that make the right behavior easier."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently frames security engineering as increasing other teams' capacity through better workflows, automation, or safeguards."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes developer enablement a central theme and shows nuanced understanding that good security tooling changes behavior by removing friction rather than adding process."}]},{"name":"Organization","description":"How clearly and logically the letter presents information and builds its case.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter reads as choppy or loosely assembled, with abrupt jumps or fragments that weaken the case."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The overall structure is understandable, but the flow is uneven and sections feel only lightly connected."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter has a clear basic structure, though some passages read more like a list of claims than a developed argument."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is well organized and easy to follow, with a logical progression from motivation to evidence."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is exceptionally coherent and readable, using framing and transitions to make the case feel polished and persuasive."}]},{"name":"Mechanics","description":"How polished the letter is at the sentence level in spelling, grammar, and proofreading.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent spelling, typo, or grammar errors are prominent enough to undermine professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Several visible errors appear throughout, though the meaning remains clear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Some errors or rough spots appear, but they only occasionally distract from the content."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The prose is mostly clean, with at most minor isolated mistakes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The prose is polished and essentially error-free throughout."}]}]}
